recentItems.description:
Watch actor Nasser's entertaining and heartfelt speech at the Sardar 2 Audio & Trailer Launch.

Nasser shares hilarious memories involving SJ Suryah, including his famous mimicry performances and how SJ Suryah's films and acting became a memorable part of his own journey. He also praises SJ Suryah's performance in Sardar 2 and predicts that he could win the Best Villain Award for the film.

Nasser goes on to speak about Karthi, director P. S. Mithran, the technical crew and the entire Sardar 2 team. He praises the film's grand visuals, performances, teamwork and the positive atmosphere created on set.

Watch the full speech from the Sardar 2 Audio & Trailer Launch and hear Nasser's hilarious moments, appreciation and special memories with the team.
